name: Desert Trotters
description: Beyond an uninhabited expanse to the far east known as the Forbidden Lands. The Hunter joins the expedition team aboard a sandship. Their mission: to aid the Keepers, and investigate the unidentified monster that destroyed the people's village, known as the White Wraith.
title: Desert Trotters

name: Back to Camp
description: After her rescue, the young girl, Nona, explains that her brother lured away a Chatacabra to protect her. The Hunter slays the monster and escorts the young man, Y'sai, back to Base Camp.
title: Back to Camp

name: The Beginning
description: Since the underground passage Nata escaped through collapsed, the expedition team must seek a path to the Keepers' village topside. For now, the Hunter is tasked with escorting Nona and Y'sai home to their village while the others finish setting up Base Camp.
title: The Beginning

name: Village of Whispering Winds
description: Since the underground passage Nata escaped through collapsed, the expedition team must seek a path to the Keepers' village topside. For now, the Hunter is tasked with escorting Nona and Y'sai home to their village while the others finish setting up Base Camp.
title: Village of Whispering Winds

name: To the Forest
description: The Avis Unit canvasses Kunafa, but find no leads on the Keepers. Instead, they learn from the village Elder that large monsters known as Doshaguma are encroaching on the human settlement. Concerned, the Hunter makes for the forest to investigate.
title: To the Forest

name: Forest Findings
description: The Avis Unit canvasses Kunafa, but find no leads on the Keepers. Instead, they learn from the village Elder that large monsters known as Doshaguma are encroaching on the human settlement. Concerned, the Hunter and company make for the forest to investigate.
title: Forest Findings

name: The Investigation Continues
description: With the Congalala defeated at the Wudwuds' request, the Hunter succeeds in reclaiming the Pop-up Camp, allowing the Doshaguma investigation to continue.
title: The Investigation Continues

name: A Hunter's Pride
description: The Hunter's investigation in the woods reveals that the Doshaguma have overcome their fear of humans and formed a pack, led by an alpha. It's only a matter of time before they descend on Kunafa. The Avis Unit races back to warn the village.
title: A Hunter's Pride

name: Pursuit of Solitude
description: After the Hunter drives the Doshaguma pack away from Kunafa and hunts its alpha, the village Elder grants the expedition team free access to the village. The Avis Unit now rides to the forest to hear Olivia's progress on the search for the White Wraith.
title: Pursuit of Solitude

name: Beyond the Deluge
description: The Avis Unit learns that Olivia and Erik's investigation into the White Wraith has brought them into the remotest reaches of the forest. Eager to hear their report and deliver Seikret for the pair's use, they ride through the rain into the forest's depths...
title: Beyond the Deluge

name: The Whispering Forest
description: Rubrum Unit's handler Kanya has a message for the Hunter, so the group heads to the Scarlet Forest Base Camp to hear what she has to say.
title: The Whispering Forest

name: Spirit in the Moonlight
description: Rubrum Unit's Kanya reports that the Wudwuds' major source of food—fish— has been disrupted, likely by a monster. The group goes to speak with Mastangler to see what's wrong, and stumble upon something unexpected.
title: Spirit in the Moonlight

name: A Looming Shadow
description: Nata confirms that the monster they saw through the downpour was their target— the White Wraith. The boy's long- suppressed rage boils to the surface and erupts. With the weather cleared and the monster nowhere in sight, the Avis Unit makes for the forest in search of its trail.
title: A Looming Shadow

name: Toward Fervent Fields
description: Zatoh tells of a land where the earth bleeds oil and its artisans who practice ancient crafting techniques. The Avis Unit sets out to meet the three tribes he spoke of to learn their ways and—with any luck—to hear word of the Keepers.
title: Toward Fervent Fields

name: An Unforeseen Storm
description: Zatoh receives word from Kunafa that an unseasonable sandstorm is bound for the village and hastens back to his home. Suspecting that the White Wraith may be in the storm's wake, the Hunter and company set out for its epicenter.
title: An Unforeseen Storm

name: The Eye of the Storm
description: Suspecting that the White Wraith might appear at the heart of the sandstorm, the Hunter's unit hurries to the Wind's Gasp...
title: The Eye of the Storm

name: A Desolate Destination
description: At the Wind's Gasp, the Hunter and company witness the White Wraith draining some form of energy from another monster before taking flight. They return to Azuz in pursuit.
title: A Desolate Destination

name: Hopes of Home
description: The people of Azuz lead the way to what appears to be an underground passage. Nata recognizes it immediately—beyond it lies the Keepers' village. The boy's heart soars at the prospect of seeing his home once more.
title: Hopes of Home

name: A Disquieting Dawn
description: Suspecting that the Landspine is a man-made structure closely tied to the strange energy they've witnessed, the Hunter and company make for Azuz to attempt to dissuade Werner from moving forward with its repair.
title: A Disquieting Dawn

name: Long-forgotten Flame
description: Perhaps due to the recent repairs to the Landspine, a sudden Firespring hits Azuz. The sudden change stokes the Everforge into an uncontrollable frenzy. The fury of nearby Ajarakan is equally sparked, and the Hunter springs into action to protect the village.
title: Long-forgotten Flame

name: Erik's Secret Request
description: Erik has sent word that there's something strange happening in the Scarlet Forest, so the group heads for the Base Camp there to hear him out.
title: Erik's Secret Request

name: Trembling Blue Currents
description: According to reports from the Sandfolk, Flameborn, and Wudwuds, a recently agitated Rathalos has become an extreme threat. Erik insists that every action has a reason, and understanding it is paramount. Thus, the Hunter joins him to investigate what has the King of the Skies so worked up.
title: Trembling Blue Currents

name: Born from the Flame
description: With the threat to Azuz abated, the expedition team reflects on their recent discoveries: the suspected man-made Landspine, and the likelihood that the region's unique ecological cycle derives from it. They return to the first Base Camp to discuss their next steps.
title: Born from the Flame

name: The Faithful Keepers
description: After the events in Azuz, it has become clear that the Landspine is likely an artificial structure from which the region derives its unique ecological cycle. With the ice that blocked the underground passage now melted, the Avis Unit once again makes for the Keepers' village.
title: The Faithful Keepers

name: Indomitable Spirit
description: The Hunter repels the White Wraith—the Guardian Arkveld. But Tasheen expresses shock upon learning that a monster with no need to feed was engaging in predation. He claims the so-called Allhearken may have answers, therein deciding the unit's next destination.
title: Indomitable Spirit

name: Nothing Frozen, Nothing Gained
description: The path to the Allhearken lies beyond a perilous region inhabited by enormous monsters, but the Hunter and company press on toward the road less traveled.
title: Nothing Frozen, Nothing Gained

name: Through the Dusk
description: After surviving the journey thanks to the combined efforts of the Hunter and Olivia, the party arrives at the home of the Allhearken.
title: Through the Dusk

name: A Path Forward
description: The Allhearken bids Nata to see for himself just what it is that Arkveld seeks to become. But to understand Arkveld, one must first understand the Guardians. The Avis Unit pursues Arkveld, resolved to find those answers.
title: A Path Forward

name: Full Circle
description: The Allhearken bids Nata to see for himself just what it is that Arkveld seeks to become. But to understand Arkveld, one must first understand the Guardians. The Avis Unit pursues Arkveld, resolved to find those answers.
title: Full Circle

name: Dawn Breaks
description: The Hunter learns of the immutable link between the Guardians and the surrounding lifeforms. The Avis Unit speculates that Arkveld too, has found a way back into the greater ecosystem.
title: Dawn Breaks

name: Broken Chains
description: The Hunter learns of the immutable link between the Guardians and the surrounding lifeforms, as Nata embraces the hope that Arkveld has slipped the Keepers' chains.
title: Broken Chains

name: Visions of Hope
description: Within the Dragontorch lurks Zoh Shia, Wyveria's secret weapon and ultimate Guardian. Stopping the torch would ensure the monster's demise—and the collapse of the entire ecosystem. Nata resolves to fulfill his duty as a Keeper as the Hunter stands beside him.
title: Visions of Hope

name: Monster Hunter
description: Within the Dragontorch lurks Zoh Shia, Wyveria's secret weapon and ultimate Guardian. As Nata hesitates to fulfill his duty, the Hunter steps up and offers him a different solution. The time to slay Zoh Shia has arrived.
title: Monster Hunter

name: Kunafa's Curious Quandary
description: There's been a concerning rumor circulating around Kunafa lately that has the villagers on edge. It might be worth looking into.
title: Kunafa's Curious Quandary

name: Clear with a Chance of Sandstorm
nameEs: Clear with a Chance of Sandstorm
description: Young Nemmo and Vuno decided to do the Seikret rider's trial on their own. Nona and the Hunter set out to the plateau in the plains to stop them, when a Seregios suddenly appears and makes off with a Seikret. Nona mounts up to give chase, with the Hunter hot on their trail.
title: Clear with a Chance of Sandstorm

name: A Visitor from the West
description: In light of the expedition team's resounding success, the Guild discusses further relations with the Eastlands, allowing the hunter and company to reunite with a certain accomplished veteran.
title: A Visitor from the West

name: New Ecosystems
description: Free of Zoh Shia's influence, the energy from the Dragontorch has put the entire Eastlands into a season of Plenty. The Avis Unit has been deployed to the Scarlet Forest to investigate. Excited for new discoveries, they advance further into the forest.
title: New Ecosystems

name: Chasing Change
description: Through their investigation of the forest, Avis Unit has proven that the Eastlands' ecosystem is reverting to its natural state. Fabius asks the group to continue their investigation, but leaves the destination up to them.
title: Chasing Change

name: Rendezvous
description: New changes have hit the Wounded Hollow, an area near Suja that has been plagued by monsters since ancient times. After a council with Fabius and the Allhearken to establish their new objectives, the group departs to investigate the valley.
title: Rendezvous

name: Lurking Shadows
description: New changes have hit the Wounded Hollow, an area near Suja that has been plagued by monsters since ancient times. After a council with Fabius and the Allhearken to establish their new objectives, the group departs to investigate the valley.
title: Lurking Shadows

name: Touring History
description: After discovering a Frenzied Nerscylla in the Wounded Hollow, Fabius returns to the Academy to conduct a full analysis. Meanwhile, assuring the Allhearken that they'll monitor the situation, Avis Unit returns to their investigation.
title: Touring History

name: To Wyvern's Rest
description: Olivia summons Avis Unit after encountering something of interest at Wyvern's Rest. This is the first time the group will set foot in the area since slaying Zoh Shia.
title: To Wyvern's Rest

name: Wyvern Sparks and Rose Thorns
description: A Lala Barina was spotted in the Ruins of Wyveria, mysteriously far from its natural habitat. Under the assumption that it must possess abnormal traits, the potential harm to the region cannot be ignored. The Hunter departs to investigate at Olivia's behest.
title: Wyvern Sparks and Rose Thorns

name: The Artifact's Words
description: It seems that Rove has discovered a "talking artifact." The Hunter heads to the Iceshard Cliffs to hear more about it straight from the eloquent Wudwud's mouth.
title: The Artifact's Words

name: The Beacon of Invasion
description: The talking artifact speaks: "Initiate invasion and subjugation." With these words, strange events begin to unfold in the Iceshard Cliffs—things the Hunter has never seen before.
title: The Beacon of Invasion

name: Premonitions
description: The appearance of a tempered monster attests to the major influence the Dragontorch's energy has on the region. Adding the Ruins of Wyveria to their list, Avis Unit once again sets out to investigate each area.
title: Premonitions

name: Omens
description: Avis Unit receives another summons from Olivia, who is stationed at the Ruins of Wyveria. It appears to be especially urgent, so the Hunter sets off for the Base Camp there.
title: Omens

name: Storm-cold Vortex
description: A tip from Nata clued the Hunter in on a frozen section of the Wyrmway. The cause seems related to the unending blizzards in the Iceshard Cliffs and the Jin Dahaad that resides there. The group ventures there, hoping to find a way to fix the flow of energy.
title: Storm-cold Vortex

name: The Root Cause
description: The energy spilling from the Dragontorch seems to be the source of all the anomalies, which leaves only one place for Avis Unit to go: the Ruins of Wyveria, where the Dragontorch lies.
title: The Root Cause

name: A Torrent of Energy
description: Upon slaying the Jin Dahaad, the Landspine returns to its normal state. However, the Dragontorch continues to emit excessive amounts of energy. With this problem on their minds, Avis Unit continues to investigate the regions.
title: A Torrent of Energy

name: A World Turned Upside Down
description: On top of a presumed connection between the excess energy from the Dragontorch and extreme weather conditions, Fabius reports that a Gore Magala is in the Eastlands. To address these simultaneous incidents, the Hunter has been tasked to go around and investigate each problem.
title: A World Turned Upside Down

name: A Break in the Clouds
description: Thanks to the team's efforts, the Dragontorch has stopped producing excessive amounts of energy. This has put an end to the anomalies, bringing a sense of normalcy back to the Eastlands. Avis Unit heads back out to experience the diverse ecosystems of each region.
title: A Break in the Clouds

name: A Peak Predicament
description: Omega and Alpha theorize that Omega Planetes is heading for Jin Dahaad, and so the group sets off for Rimechain Peak.
title: A Peak Predicament

name: Invader from the Stars
description: Omega Planetes appears from the mist, setting its sights on the one preventing it from finishing off Jin Dahaad.
title: Invader from the Stars

name: Links in a Chain
description: Nata, who has been supporting the Guild as an apprentice since the defeat of Zoh Shia, has a report for the Hunter. The group goes to hear what he has to say.
title: Links in a Chain

name: What Lies Ahead
description: Against all odds, Arkveld has been reborn. While symbolizing the indomitability of nature, its very characteristics have ironically made it a force that cannot be ignored. Deducing that it will appear next at the Rey Dau's nest, the Hunter sets off.
title: What Lies Ahead

name: An Unexpected Summons
description: The Avis Unit receives a request for assistance from an unexpected source: Werner. He requests urgent support, so the group heads to Suja to see how they can help.
title: An Unexpected Summons

name: A First Cry
description: The Dragontorch that was blocked off following Zoh Shia's defeat is now mysteriously surrounded by cocoons. The group discovers that Zoh Shia has somehow been reborn and resolves to deal with the threat once more.
title: A First Cry

name: An Ancient Resting Place
description: An expanse has been discovered deep beneath Azuz. To investigate this ancient space—which even the Flameborn have no memory of—Avis and Astrum Units head underground.
title: An Ancient Resting Place

name: Healing Help
description: Your Palico has requested that you capture Vigorwasps to help them test out their idea on a new recovery support move. It's sure to assist you in future hunts, so accept and help your Palico help you!
title: Healing Help

name: Flash Course
description: Your Palico has requested that you capture Flashflies. This time, the words "spark of inspiration" were taken literally with an idea for a support move that'll blind monsters. Ready your capture net and capture the shining bugs to shed some light on your hunts!
title: Flash Course

name: A Gutsy Move
description: Your Palico has requested that you capture Giant Vigorwasps. After much research and deliberation, your Palico finally found a solution to help you out even after you've been knocked flat. This one will really invigorate you!
title: A Gutsy Move

name: Rath-from-Above, Go!
description: Your Palico has requested that you hunt a Quematrice. Their confidence is really overflowing this time... What could they be up to? Well, if you want to know what they've got cooking, you better get out there!
title: Rath-from-Above, Go!

name: Purrfect Plundering
description: Your Palico has requested that you hunt a Guardian Ebony Odogaron. They said there's a new support move they want to try out. What is it? The best way to learn is by doing, so get out there!
title: Purrfect Plundering

name: Fishing: Life, in Microcosm
description: A fishing request from Kanya. As she preaches, "No Fishing, No Life." Well...whether you agree or not, fishing is indeed a part of a hunter's lifestyle. When the fancy strikes, go drop a line and report to Kanya after you snag your first catch.
title: Fishing: Life, in Microcosm

name: Seeking the Goldenfish
description: Kanya, your unexpectedly appointed fisherfellow, has asked you to catch a Goldenfish. She's given you a special lure for it, so go put it to good use. You should be able to find this fish in dark pools, far from the light of the sun.
title: Seeking the Goldenfish

name: Fishing for Flavor
description: Kanya has asked you to catch a Gravid Bowfin, known for its highly nutritious eggs. Catching a fish for this masterful fisherfellow could be a great way to show your appreciation!
title: Fishing for Flavor

name: The Catch of a Lifetime!
description: Kanya has asked you to catch a whopper. While they say to use big bait for a big fish, it seems this one requires a bit more  technique to reel in. They always say, "The true worth of a fisher is to be measured by the whopper they pursue," so go to the Scarlet Forest and prove yours.
title: The Catch of a Lifetime!

name: Razzle Dazzle
description: A fishing request from Kanya. This time she wants you to catch an Escunite, some of which bear a dazzling shimmer. Apparently not even your experienced fisherfellow has glimpsed one before, so get out there and hook one to share in the joy of a new discovery.
title: Razzle Dazzle

name: Dareel's Research Report
description: Dareel has asked you to catch one of the Tracktail Lizards that live in the Windward Plains. Apparently, it is particularly dire that he get it for his investigation on endemic life.
title: Dareel's Research Report

name: Samin's Research Report
description: Samin has asked you to catch a Dapperwing, which lives in the Scarlet Forest. According to him, it isn't sporting of you to only help Dareel.
title: Samin's Research Report

name: Dareel's Research Report (Cont.)
description: As a second request, Dareel has asked you to catch an Ember Rufflizard from Oilwell Basin. Although it seems he has ulterior motives behind the request, it might be best to just help him out.
title: Dareel's Research Report (Cont.)

name: Samin's Research Report (Cont.)
description: For Samin's follow-up request, he has asked you to find a Rime Beetle in the Iceshard Cliffs. He has firmly asserted that "THIS one is a proper investigation request." The more we know about endemic life the better, so let's lend him a hand.
title: Samin's Research Report (Cont.)

name: Dareel's Special Research Report
description: Now Dareel wants you to catch a rare Pillopod—also known as a Gillopod— from the Ruins of Wyveria. It seems this specimen blends in with normal Pillopods, but could be the result of a mutation.
title: Dareel's Special Research Report

name: Samin's Special Research Report
description: Now Samin wants you to catch a Sandstar at the Windward Plains. Apparently it only appears at night and is quick to flee when spotted. Might be a tricky catch, but he seems actually serious this time.
title: Samin's Special Research Report

name: High-Quality Materials
description: Gemma has asked you to fetch high- quality monster materials. She seems pretty fired up about something, but said there's no rush. Bring some back for her whenever you find time.
title: High-Quality Materials

name: Beware the Gypceros
description: It was found that the monster wreaking havoc near Kunafa was a Gypceros. According to some information from Zatoh, the Gypceros in the Windward Plains only become active during the Fallow. Go and investigate when the opportunity to strike comes.
title: Beware the Gypceros

name: Smithy's Seal of Quality
description: Gemma has invented a new hunting tool and is dying to get out on the field to test it out. It's sure to live up to expectations as always, so go and see what the hype is all about.
title: Smithy's Seal of Quality

name: Make Fluffy Dealings
description: According to Plumpeach, the change in the forest has allowed her beloved pink fur to grow strong and lush. If you accept and bring her Congalala fur, she will trade you something that may be of use in the future.
title: Make Fluffy Dealings

name: Aida's Apprehensions
description: According to Aida, a Bonefolk child ran into a Rompopolo and was injured. It appears that cases such as this have been increasing, affecting both Azuz, and the surrounding ecosystem. It can no longer be ignored. Deal with the situation quickly before anyone else gets hurt.
title: Aida's Apprehensions

name: Aberrant Atrocity
description: It is suspected that the monster that attacked Rove in Iceshard Cliffs is a Yian Kut-Ku. Moreover, it appears to be more ferocious as a result of being away from its natural habitat. This matter must be investigated.
title: Aberrant Atrocity

name: Secure Wounded Hollow
description: Cobb says two Hirabami have been spotted in Wounded Hollow. They are a big threat to the safety of the nearby Keepers and must be dealt with. Make use of the fence that Gemma has repaired while on the hunt.
title: Secure Wounded Hollow

name: A Leviathan's Temper
description: Based on Y'sai reports regarding the Vanguard's injuries, it appears to be the work of a Tempered Balahara. It must be hunted before anyone else gets hurt.
title: A Leviathan's Temper

name: Forest Doshaguma
description: Erik insists that you capture a Doshaguma from the Scarlet Forest that is "absolutely vital to the expansion of his comparative analysis of typical representations and alpha variants in the species." Go catch him one before he gets tempted to do it himself.
title: Forest Doshaguma

name: Succulent Scraps
description: Dogard has reported that an unattended scrap pile of Oricalcite nearby attracted the attention of what is assumed to be a Gravios. It must be hunted before it brings any more harm to the village.
title: Succulent Scraps

name: What We Protect
description: Alma received a report that a survey team investigating relics in the Iceshard Cliffs accidentally entered a Blangonga's territory, sending it into a rage. It has become a danger too great to leave alone and must be hunted.
title: What We Protect

name: Werner's Test Run
description: Werner claims to have created "a good one" this time. He apparently created something that utilizes the properties of Wyvern Milk. Take him along on a quest so he can test out the prototype.
title: Werner's Test Run

name: Astonishing Adaptability
description: Tasheen says a Xu Wu invaded the village, kidnapping a Keeper named Soshi. As this is an unprecedented event, the Guild decided to look into the matter immediately. While the reason for the attack is unknown, the Xu Wu must be hunted to ensure future safety.
title: Astonishing Adaptability

name: As Gatekeeper
description: Rex has reported two Ajarakan that have been spotted rampaging within Wounded Hollow. He has sent out a request for backup as his current priorities have left his hands tied. Make use of the fence as needed.
title: As Gatekeeper

name: Continuing Conflict
description: Murtabak reported two monsters fighting near Kunafa. It has been going on for days, and if left alone, could pose a  danger to the villagers. Go investigate, and take the necessary measures to ensure the safety of the village.
title: Continuing Conflict

name: Fur Damagings Are Dislikeworthy
description: Plumpeach has submitted a fur request. A Lala Barina and Congalala have been fighting in the Scarlet Forest, causing her great distress. "The fur is paying damagings! The ragings must be quelled!" A prompt hunt is requested to restore peace to us all.
title: Fur Damagings Are Dislikeworthy

name: Troublemakers
description: Sabar says that monsters in the Oilwell Basin are impeding the miners' work. Judging from the available information, it appears to be particularly dangerous Gravios and Ajarakan. They are likely different from normal, so proceed with extra caution.
title: Troublemakers

name: Echoing from the Cliffs
description: According to Apar, some monsters have been raging in the Iceshard Cliffs, which is forcing the smaller monsters to run toward Suja. Head to the cliffs to hunt the Hirabami and Blangonga at its center.
title: Echoing from the Cliffs

name: The Struggle to Survive
description: Rysher thinks he may have spotted a tempered monster in the Ruins of Wyveria. It seems the first sightings were a Xu Wu and a Guardian Ebony Odogaron. Go conduct an investigation to gauge the level of threat.
title: The Struggle to Survive

name: The Apple of Her Eye
description: Alma lost her beloved glasses while investigating the Scarlet Forest. Perhaps the Wudwuds who were around know something.
title: The Apple of Her Eye

name: Ultimate Strength
description: Vespae Unit handler Quinn reports that there has been a significant decrease in sightings of tempered monsters in the Oilwell Basin. Search the middle and upper strata of the Oilwell Basin to see if you can find out what's going on.
title: Ultimate Strength

name: New Fashion, Old Feelings
description: Gemma calls upon the Hunter to help her put together a friendly fashion contest between the other units. Once each smithy decks their hunter out in the chosen Layered Armor, it's time to roll out the red carpet for "Project Fashion Hunter: Busting Down the Door to Progress"!
title: New Fashion, Old Feelings

name: Awakening the Past
description: Laying dormant in the ancient expanse was Gogmazios, a creature categorized as an elder dragon. To defeat it, Werner proposes reactivating and using the ancient weapon that has been lodged in Gogmazios's back.
title: Awakening the Past

name: Ghosts Pay No Heed to Tomorrow
nameEs: Ghosts Pay No Heed to Tomorrow
description: Gogmazios has vanished like a ghost. Seizing this opportunity, the smithing team sets off to repair the Wyvern Milk energy nexus needed to operate an ancient weapon. Fearing for their safety, the Guild must nonetheless mobilize all its resources for the hard battle to come.
title: Ghosts Pay No Heed to Tomorrow

name: Hot on Their Tails
description: We've spotted an SOS Flare from the Support Team and have confirmed that a Quematrice is after their goods. At this rate, the monster will follow that tasty meat straight to Base Camp! You have to stop them!
title: Hot on Their Tails

name: A Stage of Rose and Thorn
nameEs: A Stage of Rose and Thorn
description: Erik of the Astrum Unit was rescued after being captured by a Lala Barina. It is likely to retaliate over the loss of its prey. Please go hunt them to avoid further victims.
title: A Stage of Rose and Thorn

name: Drive Off the Congalala!
description: Big creature is dis-dressing honey mountain. Yes yes, pink fur is prettyful—but smoke has the stink. BIG stink. You drive creature away, we give you puny hovel!
title: Drive Off the Congalala!

name: Balahara of the Sandsea
description: The Vanguard leader was injured by Balahara while fleeing. The monsters unfortunately picked up his scent, which will lead them straight to Kunafa. Please go hunt them, for everyone's safety.
title: Balahara of the Sandsea

name: A Feast in the Deep
description: Spotted unknown monster beneath the water during investigation. Was careless. Fought to protect crew, but  became target. Identifiable by its water-like veils. Requesting assistance to drive off the monster.
title: A Feast in the Deep

name: A Fuse Ignited
description: It's highly likely that a girl of the Oilfolk has wandered into monster territory. Please go hunt the Rompopolo, for everyone's safety.
title: A Fuse Ignited

name: A Merciless Glare
description: A monster—suspected to be the desert's apex predator— and the White Wraith have been spotted atop Wind's Gasp. The apex predator began to rampage in the wake of the White Wraith's absence. The monster must be slain for the safety of the village.
title: A Merciless Glare

name: The Quiet, Cunning Assassin
description: It's that giant spider. So this is my death... Nay, life would be preferred. Oh, has a new death come for me? Or is it my salvation? I shall leave it to fate.
title: The Quiet, Cunning Assassin

name: Fight or Flight
description: Avis Unit member Nata has come down with a fever. Hunt the Hirabami to clear the path to Azuz in order to get him back safely.
title: Fight or Flight

name: Ajarakan Ablaze
description: Mending the Landspine has caused Inclemency to occur in Oilwell Basin and now a number of Ajarakan are attacking Azuz. Please go hunt them to ensure the village's safety.
title: Ajarakan Ablaze

name: An Ominous Encounter
description: We encountered a white Doshaguma while searching the Keepers' Vigil. That is, it looked like a Doshaguma, but its behavior was...strange. Was it really a Doshaguma?
title: An Ominous Encounter

name: The Ashen King
description: It was a Rathalos, king of the skies, that attacked the door we suspect leads to the Village of the Keepers! It appears to have similar characteristics to the white Doshaguma we found previously. Slay this monster before it brings harm to the Keepers.
title: The Ashen King

name: Repel the
description: The White Wraith, Guardian Arkveld. The mysteries surrounding this monster run deep. For now, we must prioritize the search and rescue of two missing Keepers. Guardian Arkveld must be driven off.
title: Repel the

name: The Rimechain Trial
description: We must get to Suja and locate the Allhearken, but a huge monster freezing the peaks of the mountain is blocking the path. It must be driven off to ensure the safety of all.
title: The Rimechain Trial

name: Watcher of the Ancient Capital
description: While surveying the ecology within Wyveria, we encountered an extremely territorial Guardian Ebony Odogaron. Fleeing or hiding from this beast is not an option. The Guild requests that you slay it to ensure the safety of the area.
title: Watcher of the Ancient Capital

name: A Hunter in the Void
description: Wyveria is home to a monster that preys upon Guardians. Please go hunt this monster for everyone's safety and our continued research of this ecosystem.
title: A Hunter in the Void

name: The Pale Dream of a Lone Shadow
nameEs: The Pale Dream of a Lone Shadow
description: Now that the Guardian Arkveld has learned how to feed, it has gone berserk and is attacking everything in sight. It must be slain in order to restore balance to the ecosystem.
title: The Pale Dream of a Lone Shadow

name: Guardian Zoh Shia
description: The Guardian that has slept for eons in the thrall of the Dragontorch now teeters on the edge of awakening. The time to slay Zoh Shia has come.
title: Guardian Zoh Shia

name: The Black Flame Quietly Manifests
description: Inclemency has caused havoc in the Everforge, summoning a monster clad in dark flames from the depths of Oilwell Basin. Please hunt this monster to ensure the village's safety.
title: The Black Flame Quietly Manifests

name: Pinnacle of the Pack
description: A pack of Doshaguma is closing in on Kunafa. Hunt the alpha and the rest should scatter. Please—for everyone's safety.
title: Pinnacle of the Pack

name: Lured by Abundance
description: A group of Yian Kut-Ku has been sighted in the Scarlet Forest that has entered the season of Plenty. Unfortunately, one was hit by a Wudwud paintball, and now they're all on alert. Please capture the specified monster for the sake of our investigation.
title: Lured by Abundance

name: Frozen Lord on the Precipice
description: Jin Dahaad activity has been confirmed as the cause of the frozen Wyrmway in Oilwell Basin. According to Nata's report, we're lucky to have discovered this before the damage spread further. Slay it before it starts affecting other areas.
title: Frozen Lord on the Precipice

name: Roaring Rey Dau
description: We sighted a Rey Dau on a plateau not far out. Even from afar, its fury was clear to see. It was terrifying... So we decided to evacuate the village, before anything happened.
title: Roaring Rey Dau

name: Tide Overtaking Timber
description: Big rain fall, fall, fall. Water go WHOOSH! Whole forest BIG wettings! Lord of forest, different. Big angry! More water go WHOOSH! Tim work together. Copper-ate!
title: Tide Overtaking Timber

name: Scorching the Earth Once More
description: That thing... The Black Flame. It's just outside the village. By swallowing the valley's fire, it's grown far hotter than before—and I'm afraid it's something we simply cannot handle.
title: Scorching the Earth Once More

name: Awaking From a Dream
description: For the safety of the surrounding regions, you have been authorized to slay Arkveld. Based on all the reports of destruction caused by this monster, it is of the utmost threat. Approach with extreme caution.
title: Awaking From a Dream

name: Thundering Flowers
description: A tempered Lala Barina has caused a Guardian Fulgur Anjanath to emerge from its cocoon. Is this a natural occurrence here in Wyveria, I wonder? Whatever the case may be, the Guild's mission is clear: hunt both monsters.
title: Thundering Flowers

name: Investigating the Frenzied Shadow
description: There's been a sighting of a Nerscylla thought to be infected with the Frenzy in Wounded Hollow. Please hunt it quickly before it endangers other areas of the Forbidden Lands.
title: Investigating the Frenzied Shadow

name: Shrouded in Black
description: Gore Magala was found inhabiting in the Iceshard Cliffs. We were able to corner it with the help of Rex and Cobb, but as its existence could prove calamitous to the native environment, we must neutralize it.
title: Shrouded in Black

name: The Desert Knows Not the Sea
nameEs: The Desert Knows Not the Sea
title: The Desert Knows Not the Sea
